description: This file defines a class 'Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop' which extends an abstract device class, representing a desktop browser user agent parser/matcher within the Zend Framework HTTP UserAgent package.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop
classes.description: A class representing a desktop user agent, provides methods to match user agents and return the type.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to determine if a user agent matches this desktop profile; always returns true.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Instance method returning the string 'desktop' indicating the browser type.
